clients.decision_required: stage for imported legacy master clients

waves.name: baseline_and_journal
waves.scope: Create retained pre-apply snapshot, immutable manifest and migration journal in homologation.

waves.name: clients
rules: Exact CNPJ/name matches are map-only and never update existing clients.
New IDs are UUIDv5 deterministic by tenant/domain/source id.
cli4 is resolved with the current ERP collision rules; frozen cli4 is never overwritten.
Imported lifecycle stage requires explicit business approval before apply.

waves.name: suppliers
rules: Only unique normalized CNPJ can become an insert.
Name similarity is not an automatic match.
Internal supplier codes are allocated by the current ERP sequence during apply.
Counter before-image is mandatory for exact rollback.

waves.name: materials_and_fragrances
waves.blocker: Human domain classification and governed internal-code decision required.

waves.name: skus_formulas_bom
waves.blocker: Historical SKU lookup, contractual validity and material dependencies unresolved; no SKU auto-generation.

waves.name: orders_and_ops
waves.blocker: Client, SKU, CGI and order dependencies unresolved; production postings will not be replayed.

waves.name: physical_stock_wms_cq
waves.blocker: Physical cutoff, addresses and CQ/WMS approval required; saldoAtual and legacy movements are history only.

apply_gate: A separate explicit authorization is required after reviewing this plan and resolving wave decisions.
